item.label: Namchi, South Sikkim (hill town) · Maxar WorldView 2022-03-14 · 0.5 m · Mode B
item.source: Maxar Open Data Program (CC BY-NC 4.0), acquisition 1040010073381800; Dense hill town on steep slopes; district HQ of Namchi (South Sikkim).

points.datum_handling: checkpoint heights converted ellipsoidal -> EGM2008 (C-1 guarded, offline geoid grids)
caveats: ICESat-2 segments are ~20 m long and ~11 m wide; raster values are summarised in a disk around each segment centre, so steep slopes add sampling error.
ICESat-2 acquisitions span several years; construction, clearing or tree growth since then appears as error.
h_canopy (ATL08-style) measures the top of vegetation AND of buildings above ground; it is a sparse, independent check, not a dense LiDAR reference.
